An abandoned '''power plant''' was located in the [[Tularan Marsh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Radioactivity from the plant's reactor affected the [[rakghoul]]s living within it over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and evolved them, turning them into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[nekghoul]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
In the Republic version of the planet Taris, the power plant is located in the Forgotten Undercity subzone of the [[Tularan Marsh]]. However, the Imperial version moves the power plant to the [[Shattered Pipeworks]] area of the marsh, taking the place of the [[Project Quell Research Lab]]. As the Quell lab must also exist, the power plant must be located in the Forgotten Undercity.
